name: Notion (notion.com marketing system, token layer "Tatami")
licence: Proprietary. No published tokens or component library; the Tatami token layer was read from the live public stylesheets (1758 custom properties, 1043 non-empty). Study structure and values only; NotionInter, Lyon Text and the illustration style are licensed/branded. Product app (logged-in UI) not measured.
bestFor: horizontal productivity, workspace and AI-assistant SaaS for broad audiences
marketing that mixes heavy grotesk headlines with hand-drawn illustration and pastel chips
token systems that need a full per-state component matrix
light, warm-neutral, high-text-contrast pages (alpha-black text on white)
avoidFor: dark-first or developer-tool brands (marketing is light only)
premium/luxury minimalism (heavy 600-700 headlines and cartoon art are the opposite)
teams that need precise cross-surface greys on tinted backgrounds (text is alpha black, not solid ramps)
dense enterprise dashboards (marketing density only was measured)

families: NotionInter (Notion's customised Inter; weights 400, 500, 600, 700 plus variable-weight tokens 420, 520, 620, 680; fallback Inter, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica; features "lnum" 1, "locl" 0)
Lyon Text (serif; 4 text nodes on home; serif tokens 200-900 with 0 tracking up to size 600)
iA Writer Mono (mono; fallback Nitti, Menlo, Courier)

scale.role: font-size-100 / small, button small, menu button

typography.notes: Tokens: --tatami-font-size-{50,100,150,200,300,350,400,500,600,700,800,900,1000,1100} = .75, .875, .9375, 1, 1.125, 1.25, 1.375, 1.625, 2, 2.625, 3.375, 4, 4.75, 6rem; line heights 1, 1.25, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 1.75, 1.75, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 5, 6.25rem. Letter-spacing is a token per size AND weight (e.g. 800 regular -0.21875rem, semibold/bold -0.117188rem; 1100 semibold -0.2875rem): regular weight tracks tighter than bold at the same size (700 regular -2px vs bold -1.5px). Typography tokens are complete font shorthands per size and weight (--tatami-typography-sans-200-medium-font: 500 1rem / 1.5rem NotionInter ...). Interaction styles: button-small 500 14/20, button-medium 500 16/24, button-large 600 16/24, menu-button 400 14/20, all 0 tracking. Hero h1 includes an inline pill ('Ship', green chip) inside the headline. Measured 2026-10-08 at 1440 and 390 on notion.com, /pricing, /help.

neutrals.text (measured): primary rgba(0,0,0,0.95) / 0.898 (42 nodes) / secondary rgba(0,0,0,0.54) / 0.59; solid rgb(97,93,89) = gray-600 for captions; rgb(120,115,111) = gray-500

semantic.note: Semantic status tokens are expressed through the nine-step hue ramps; named semantic aliases beyond buttons were not enumerated.

color.darkMode: Marketing is light-only (body white under prefers-color-scheme: dark, measured 2026-10-08). The token set includes alpha-white 100-900 and per-button alpha variants (action-button-alpha) so inverse surfaces exist, but a dark theme was not observed. Product app dark mode: unknown (not accessible).
color.contrastNotes: Computed WCAG on white: white on #0075de 4.57:1 (just above AA); #005bab on #e6f3fe 6.04:1; gray-500 #78736f 4.69:1; gray-600 #615d59 6.53:1; rgba(0,0,0,0.54) renders about #757575 = 4.6:1. Primary body rgba(0,0,0,0.898) is about 15:1. Alpha-based text means contrast depends on the surface; tinted pastel chips need a re-check.

spacing.base: 4px (--tatami-dimension-spacing-N in px names, rem values). Notes: Named by pixel value (spacing-16 = 1rem). Sizes: --tatami-dimension-size-960 (60rem) and -1252 (78.25rem) for content widths; offsets 0/1/2px; thickness 1/2px. Breakpoints in media queries: 375, 600, 840, 1080, 1280, 1440px (min-width). Nav pad 5px 10px on 30px buttons. Hero frame inset about 240px at 1440 (product screenshot x=240).

radius.rule: Tokens --tatami-border-radius-0/200/300/400/500/600/700/800/900/round = 0, .25, .3125, .375, .5, .625, .75, .875, 1rem, pill. Components: button .5rem (large .625rem), icon-button .25rem, menu-button pill. Measured on home: 8px x67, 4px x22, 12px x17, pill x7, 16px x2; pricing table rows 5px x112.

shadows: measured pricing small: rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 0 1px 4px (x85 table marker/pill elements)
depth.borders: Very low-contrast: 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1). Shadows are multi-layer, near-zero opacity (2-10%) so cards float without visible edges. Tertiary buttons have a 1px #0000001a border; secondary and primary have transparent borders (primary also keeps a 1px white-alpha border so geometry matches).

easings: cubic-bezier(0.42, 0, 1, 1) ease-in (200ms background/colour/text-decoration/outline on links and buttons: x27, x23, x17)
cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1) quart; cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) quad; cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.5, 1) linear-ish
motion.notes: Duration tokens 100/150/200/250/300ms; hover states on this site use ease-in (slow start) rather than ease-out, unusual; 11 prefers-reduced-motion media blocks exist in the stylesheets. z-index tokens: header 100, banner 90, mobile-nav 200, popup/lightbox/tooltip 500.

list: cookie dialog (Accept all, Reject all, More options)
components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Explicit and complete at token level for buttons: each variant has background, background-hover, background-focus, background-active, text, border (primary #0075de -> #005bab on hover, focus and active; secondary #e6f3fe -> #f2f9ff; tertiary #fff -> #f6f5f4 with #0000001a border; ghost transparent -> #f6f5f4 with #78736f indicator); icon-button #a39e98 -> #615d59 with 5% bg; menu-button rest #f9f9f8, hover/focus/active #f6f5f4, selected #f6f5f4 with border #0000001a / #0003. Disabled tokens exist for action-button icons (#0000004d). Hover, focus and active are separate tokens even when values are equal.

tokenArchitecture: Tatami, three tiers in CSS custom properties with the --tatami- prefix: (1) primitives named by scale step: --tatami-color-{hue}-{100..900}, --tatami-color-alpha-{black|white}-{100..900}, --tatami-dimension-spacing-{px}, --tatami-font-size-{50..1100}, --tatami-font-line-height-*, --tatami-font-letter-spacing-{sans|serif|mono}-{size}[-weight], --tatami-border-radius-{200..900|round}, --tatami-shadow-{0,100,200,300}, --tatami-motion-duration-*, --tatami-motion-timing-function-*; (2) semantic/component tokens that reference primitives and carry state in the name: --tatami-color-button-primary-background-hover, --tatami-color-menu-button-border-selected-active, --tatami-border-button-radius-lg, --tatami-typography-interaction-button-medium-font (a whole font shorthand), --tatami-typography-sans-{step}-{weight}-{font|letter-spacing|font-feature-settings}; (3) campaign namespaces (--tatami-color-campaigns-agents-launch-*, ...-dev-platform-dos-*) for time-boxed palettes. Component radius tokens appear twice in the stylesheet with different values (button radius 0 in one scope, .5rem in another; scope not identified), so radius is re-pointable per scope.
distinctiveness: Heavy (600-700) Inter-derived grotesk set huge (96px) with very tight tracking (-0.048em); alpha-black ink rather than a coloured ink; warm yellow-brown greys; hand-drawn black-outline illustrations and cartoon characters beside real product screenshots; inline pastel pill chips inside headlines ('Ship' in a green pill); nearly invisible layered shadows; a serif (Lyon) held in reserve. Generic SaaS copies the pill and the big heading but not the tracking-per-weight table, the warm greys or the illustration voice.
weaknesses: text greys are alpha black, so contrast changes with the surface and pastel chips need individual checks
primary button contrast is 4.57:1, barely AA
hover transitions use ease-in (delayed start), which feels sluggish compared with ease-out
tokens for dark mode are not exposed on the marketing site; app UI not available for study
very large hero (96px, 2 lines plus chip) pushes proof below the fold at 900px height; cookie dialog (about 400px wide) overlaps the right of the fold at 1440
campaign palettes live in the same token namespace as the core, risking brand drift
takeaways: Make every type token a full shorthand (size, line-height, family, weight) with a sibling letter-spacing token per size and weight
Track regular weights tighter than bold at the same display size; encode that in tokens, do not apply one global value
Name state in tokens (-hover, -focus, -active, -selected, -disabled) even when values coincide, so the state matrix is complete and auditable
Keep time-boxed campaign palettes in their own namespace, never mutating core colours
Use alpha-black ink and alpha borders for warm light surfaces, but verify contrast on every tinted background
Layer 4-6 near-zero-opacity shadows so cards float without visible edges
Allow one playful device (inline pill chip in a headline, illustration) against a disciplined grotesk system
Name spacing tokens by their pixel value; name type tokens by an open-ended numeric scale (50...1100) so steps can be inserted
